structured_output.world_model: W4 after E007. Best is 7.33 s at 0.7590 (margin 0.6 pp). Noise: per-seed std about 0.3 pp, 3-seed mean std about 0.15-0.2 pp, time noise about 1-2% (0.1 s). Runs are near-deterministic per seed, but any recipe change reshuffles the trajectory by about 0.2 pp. Most small tweaks (LR floor, BN recompute, width cut) should be null within noise. Epoch trims cost accuracy at about 0.3 pp per 0.5 epoch and save about 5% time. Aggressive resolution cuts probably cost more accuracy than they save in time. CUDA graphs should give small gains with 4 CPUs, but Muon's compiled update and a changing LR may complicate capture.

forecasts.reason: Trimming 0.5 epoch saves about 5% of time and costs about 0.3 pp, so it likely stays above 0.753 but with a thin margin.
Time is unchanged. EMA already captures most of the end-of-schedule benefit, so the expected gain is within noise, about +0.05 pp.
Saves about 10% of time, but 20 px for 30% of steps probably costs 0.5-1 pp, landing near the 0.753 bar.
Width 512 saves about 3-4% of FLOPs, with a small accuracy loss that is hard to resolve from noise.
Held-out seeds will likely average 0.1-0.2 pp below the seeds 0-2 mean (regression to the mean), with std about 0.3 pp. The first epoch is probably slower.
Likely a small gain of 0-8% if capture works. Risk of a failed capture or a slowdown from the optimizer and LR handling.
BN stats under the EMA weights are already roughly consistent because buffers are averaged too. Gain is likely under 0.3 pp and the cost is about 0.1 s.
